description: Rick Tanner requests an in-person sit-down with Patricia Hawkins in her new owner-operator capacity to clarify his role in the restructured organization, confirm Q2 operational authority over the Millfield location, and raise the question of a stay bonus for floor sales staff.
expected_outcome: Clarification of GM role post-restructuring and Q2 operational plan alignment
secondary_description: Rick accepts Jake Morrison's one-on-one request and will meet with him this week to review floor sales data and discuss stay bonus question
